title: Light Redirector
description:
The Light Redirector switches the model of a block placed next to it with the model of the block that is on the opposite side of it. Right clicking one of the sides will disable it; right clicking it again enables it again. Blocks on disabled sides won't change appearance. You can for example use it to make blocks like lamps look like normal blocks.

The effect is visual only: it does not change real lighting or collision.

properties.label: Right click
properties.value: Toggles that side on or off (all sides start enabled)
